svg.text: Dotnet · D08 · Bounded capacity makes overload explicit
Producers, a cap, workers, and a full-channel policy.
Wait, drop, or reject — pick one and measure it.
Unbounded queues turn spikes into outages.
Shutdown is part of the design
Complete the writer. Drain. Propagate errors.
Propagate terminal error, do not swallow
how much memory you will hold

text.tspan: Capacity, writer-at-full, worker count, drain on stop
Failed items retry or quarantine — completion still
Hide overload in an unbounded queue
Kill the process with items still in memory, no
